candidates.change_summary: Change paused() to always return the inverse of the stored _paused value (negates result).
Replace UtilLib.checkNonZeroAddress(lrtConfigAddr); with a no-op (removed) so updateLRTConfig accepts zero address and sets lrtConfig to address(0).
Change assignment to set lrtConfig to ILRTConfig(msg.sender) instead of the provided address, making updateLRTConfig set lrtConfig to the caller.
Modify onlyLRTAdmin to check for MANAGER role instead of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, changing who may call updateLRTConfig.
